hotspots.title: Trump administration approves $2.8B weapons sale to Israel
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration's approval of a $2.8 billion arms deal to send 40,000 heavy 2,000-pound bombs to Israel has triggered widespread coverage and intense political friction. The decision reverses previous pauses on heavy munitions and has drawn an immediate congressional hold from top Democrats amid ongoing Middle East conflict.
hotspots.affect: High geopolitical military stakes combined with congressional intervention create an intense focal point for policy debate and outrage.

hotspots.title: State lawsuits and court rulings challenge Trump administration policies
hotspots.blurb: Federal courts and state attorneys general have mounted significant legal barriers against key administration initiatives. Decisions blocking mail-in ballot restrictions, national voter citizenship database usage, and federal grant censorship have collided with new multi-state lawsuits targeting immigration public benefit rules.
hotspots.affect: High-stakes constitutional clashes and multi-state legal pushback carry high affective investment over democratic rules and executive overreach.

hotspots.title: Norway's Progress Party surges past Conservative rivals in polls
hotspots.blurb: Norway's right-wing Progress Party (Frp) has expanded its lead to a historic 32.5% in public polling, more than doubling its main conservative rival Høyre. The unprecedented polling gap has triggered sharp coalition friction over corporate tax policy and alarmed opponents over a potential Frp-led government.
hotspots.affect: A dramatic political realignment in the Norwegian right creates intense party competition and existential panic among coalition rivals.

hotspots.title: GOP Rep. Massie forces impeachment vote against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: Republican Representative Thomas Massie has forced a House floor vote on impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the military action in Iran. The maneuver exposes acute intra-party conflict within the GOP over war powers authority and foreign intervention.
hotspots.affect: Rare intra-party impeachment proceedings against a sitting cabinet official generate sharp drama and ideological grievance.

hotspots.title: Sweden Democrats suffer sharp municipal election setback
hotspots.blurb: Post-election analyses confirm significant vote share declines for the Sweden Democrats (SD) across several municipal elections, dropping from over 20% to under 18%. Commentators and rival parties are highlighting internal factional friction and historical controversies following the losses.
hotspots.affect: Uncharacteristic electoral contraction for a prominent right-wing populist party invites intense scrutiny and partisan recrimination.
